title: The Poems of John Donne - Easton Press Leather  100 Greatest Collector's Edition
descriptionText: This is a rare and highly sought-after collector's edition of "The Poems of John Donne" by Easton Press. The book is bound in premium leather and features 100 great gatherings that make it a valuable addition to any library. The poetry is written in English and was printed in 1979 in the United States. The book is illustrated by Imre Reiner and includes special attributes that make it a unique collector's item. The author, John Donne, is well-known for his poetic works and this edition is a must-have for any poetry enthusiast. The book is perfect for those who appreciate literature and fiction and is sure to be a conversation starter in any room.
